## Summary

Describe the user or developer problem this change addresses and the approach taken.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` when interaction behavior changes
- [ ] Registry payloads rebuilt when source changes
- [ ] Physical-device results recorded when safe areas, keyboards, gestures, installation, or standalone mode change

## Compatibility

Note any API, browser, accessibility, or migration impact. Write “None” when there is no known impact.
